title: Binary and Number Bases: Short Answer
instructions: Reminder: each binary place is a power of two. Add the places that have a 1. One byte contains 8 bits.

questions.prompt: How many bits are in one byte, and what is the largest decimal number one byte can hold?
answers: One byte contains 8 bits, and the largest unsigned decimal value it can hold is 255 (1111 1111 in binary).
